L10@P0: Ignition!
L11@P0: An Informal History of Liquid Rocket Propellants
L12@P0: by John Drury Clark
L13@P0: Foreword by Isaac Asimov
L14@P0: DESCRIPTION
L15@P0: A classic work in the history of science, and described as “a good book on rocket
L16@P0: stuff…that’s a really fun one” by SpaceX founder Elon Musk, readers will want to
L17@P0: get their hands on this influential classic, available for the first time in decades.
L18@P0: This newly reissued debut book in the Rutgers University Press Classics imprint is the story
L19@P0: of the search for a rocket propellant which could be trusted to take man into space. This
L20@P0: search was a hazardous enterprise carried out by rival labs who worked against the known
L21@P0: laws of nature, with no guarantee of success or safety.
L22@P0: Acclaimed scientist and sci-fi author John Drury Clark writes with irreverent and eyewitness
L23@P0: immediacy about the development of the explosive fuels strong enough to negate the
L24@P0: relentless restraints of gravity. The resulting volume is as much a memoir as a work of
L25@P0: history, sharing a behind-the-scenes view of an enterprise which eventually took men to the
L26@P0: moon, missiles to the planets, and satellites to outer space.
L27@P0: AUTHOR/EDITOR BIOGRAPHY
L28@P0: JOHN DRURY CLARK (1907 - 1988) was an American rocket fuel developer, chemist, and
L29@P0: science fiction writer. In addition to his work as a scientist, he was instrumental in the broad
L30@P0: revival of interest in Robert E. Howard’s Conan stories and an influence on the writing of
L31@P0: Isaac Asimov, L. Sprague de Camp, Fletcher Pratt, and other sci-fi authors.
L32@P0: ISAAC ASIMOV (1920 - 1992) was an American author and professor of biochemistry at
L33@P0: Boston University, best known for his works of science fiction and for his popular science
L34@P0: books. A prolific writer, he published more than 500 books, most notably the science fiction
L35@P0: novels I, Robot and Foundation, and the popular science works, Guide to Science and
L36@P0: Understanding Physics.

L79: ### About the author (2002)
L80: 
L81: Geoffrey Moore is chairman emeritus of three consulting firms—The Chasm Group, Chasm Institute, and TCG Advisors—all of which provide marketing strategy and organizational advice to leading high-technology companies. Moore is also a venture partner with Mohr Davidow Ventures, a California-based venture capital firm specializing in specific technology markets, including e-commerce, Internet, enterprise software, networking, and semiconductors.
